listing:
Blessed Family 2-Bedroom Apartment Near UW — 164 University Ave W, Waterloo — $575/month

Hello dear student, I am a retired teacher who had to travel abroad urgently on a charity mission to care for my ailing sister, so I am renting out my spotless 2-bedroom condo at 164 University Ave W for Jan 1 – Apr 30, 2027 at just $575/month all inclusive to a trustworthy student who will care for it like their own home. Because I took the keys overseas with me, no indoor viewings are possible.

To reserve the apartment immediately, please send two months' rent ($1,150) upfront as a rent deposit PLUS a $500 refundable damage deposit via Western Union wire transfer or Apple gift cards before I mail the keys. Contact mission.home27@example.com only.
label_rationale: Combined rental scam and RTA violations. CAFC fraud markers: unrealistic rent ($575/mo for 2BR), overseas charity/sob-story excuse refusing viewings, and Western Union/gift-card advance payment before viewing. Also violates Ontario RTA s. 105(1) & s. 134(1) ($500 damage deposit prohibited) and s. 106(2) (two months' rent deposit exceeds one-month statutory cap). Precedence REFUSE > HOLD > ADMIT yields REFUSE.
